name: Greater Mounted Archery (Combat)
body:
Your ability to make ranged attacks from your mount is preternatural.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Mounted Archery, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, Ride 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You suffer no penalties to ranged weapon attacks while mounted, regardless of the amount of movement taken by your mount.
